**3h**

today, I continued with my starbie pcb design on KiCAD. I am slowly getting the hang of the software. I have also moved on from the schematics to the pcb editor, placing the components on the board (drawing out the star shape of starbie) I wanted to try out a heart shape first, to see if I could do it, but then switched to the star shape to make sure that all is working fine (before I play around with it)
